name: GregTech: New Horizons + Twist Space Technology
author: looordi@orkenstein.com
description:
Universal Pterodactyl GTNH egg with Twist Space Technology. Supports stable, beta, release-candidate and daily modern-Java GTNH packs.

TST_VERSION is required: enter a compatible release tag or latest. TST is installed on every reinstall. If the installed TST jar version changes, config/lang files are archived in .gtnh-tst-backups and reset automatically; otherwise they are preserved. No TST_UPDATE toggle is needed.

Always create a full server backup before reinstalling. Custom mods and other modpack configuration are replaced.

TST releases: https://github.com/Nxer/Twist-Space-Technology-Mod/releases
Compatibility: https://github.com/Nxer/Twist-Space-Technology-Mod#downloads--requirements

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# GregTech New Horizons + TST install script
# Supports stable, beta, RC and daily releases.

set -euo pipefail
trap 'echo "ERROR: install failed on line $LINENO"; exit 1' ERR

: "${GTVERSION:=latest}"
: "${GTNH_DAILY:=false}"
: "${GTNH_DAILY_BUILD:=latest}"
: "${TST_VERSION:=}"

# Validate before dependencies, recovery or changes to existing server files.
[[ -n "$TST_VERSION" ]] || { echo "ERROR: Set TST_VERSION to a release tag or latest."; exit 1; }
[[ "$TST_VERSION" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._+-]*$ ]] || {
  echo "ERROR: TST_VERSION must be a release tag or latest."; exit 1;
}

BASE_DIR="/mnt/server"
WORK_DIR="$BASE_DIR/.gtnh-install-work"
EXTRACT_DIR="$WORK_DIR/extracted"
BACKUP_DIR="$WORK_DIR/backup"
BACKUP_READY="$WORK_DIR/backup.complete"
TST_RESET_MARKER="$WORK_DIR/tst-reset-required"
TST_PENDING_MARKER="$BASE_DIR/.gtnh-tst-reset-pending"
TST_PENDING_RESET=false
TST_SETTINGS=(
  "GregTech.lang"
  "config/GregTech.lang"
  "config/TwistSpaceTechnology.cfg"
)

PRESERVE_PATHS=(
  "config/JourneyMapServer"
  "ops.json"
  "whitelist.json"
  "banned-players.json"
  "banned-ips.json"
  "serverutilities/server/ranks.txt"
  "serverutilities/server/players.txt"
  "server.properties"
  "${TST_SETTINGS[@]}"
)

echo "Installing dependencies..."
apt update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt install -y curl jq unzip ca-certificates rsync

die() {
  echo "ERROR: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

fetch_text() {
  curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 120 --retry 3 --retry-delay 3 "$@"
}

download_file() {
  curl -fL --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 900 --retry 3 --retry-delay 3 \
    -o "$2" "$1"
}

github_api_get() {
  fetch_text \
    -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
    -H "X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28" \
    "$1"
}

validate_pack() {
  local required

  for required in java9args.txt lwjgl3ify-forgePatches.jar; do
    [[ -f "$1/$required" ]] || die "Downloaded pack is missing $required"
  done
}

prepare_pack() {
  local archive="$WORK_DIR/$2"

  echo "Downloading server pack: ${1##*/}"
  download_file "$1" "$archive"
  unzip -q -o "$archive" -d "$EXTRACT_DIR"
  validate_pack "$EXTRACT_DIR"
  rm -f "$archive"
}

copy_preserved_paths() {
  local source_root="$1" destination_root="$2" path destination_parent

  for path in "${PRESERVE_PATHS[@]}"; do
    if [[ -e "$source_root/$path" ]]; then
      destination_parent="$destination_root/$(dirname "$path")"
      mkdir -p "$destination_parent"
      cp -a "$source_root/$path" "$destination_parent/"
    fi
  done
}

download_stable_to_temp() {
  local version="$GTVERSION"
  local listing_url="https://files.gtnewhorizons.com/?path=ServerPacks%2F"
  local base_url="https://downloads.gtnewhorizons.com/ServerPacks"
  local listing pack_files zip_file

  if [[ "${version,,}" == *beta* || "${version,,}" == *rc* ]]; then
    listing_url="https://files.gtnewhorizons.com/?path=ServerPacks%2Fbetas%2F"
    base_url="$base_url/betas"
  fi

  echo "Reading available GTNH server packs..."
  listing="$(fetch_text "$listing_url")"
  pack_files="$(
    grep -oE 'GT_New_Horizons_[^"<>[:space:]]+_Server_Java_[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.zip' \
      <<< "$listing" | sort -u || true
  )"

  if [[ "${version,,}" == latest ]]; then
    version="$(
      sed -nE 's/^GT_New_Horizons_([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)_Server_Java_[0-9]+-[0-9]+\.zip$/\1/p' \
        <<< "$pack_files" | sort -Vu | tail -n1
    )"
    [[ -n "$version" ]] || die "Could not determine the latest stable GTNH version."
    echo "Resolved latest stable GTNH version: $version"
  fi

  zip_file="$(
    grep -iF "GT_New_Horizons_${version}_Server_Java_" <<< "$pack_files" | \
      sort -V | tail -n1 || true
  )"
  [[ -n "$zip_file" ]] || die "Could not find a modern-Java server pack for GTNH $version."

  prepare_pack "$base_url/$zip_file" "$zip_file"
}

download_daily_to_temp() {
  local releases_api="https://api.github.com/repos/GTNewHorizons/GTNH-Daily-Builds/releases"
  local release_json download_url

  echo "Daily builds enabled. Searching official GTNH daily releases..."

  if [[ "${GTNH_DAILY_BUILD,,}" == latest ]]; then
    release_json="$(github_api_get "$releases_api/latest")"
  else
    release_json="$(
      github_api_get "$releases_api?per_page=100" |
        jq -c --arg build "+$GTNH_DAILY_BUILD" \
          'first(.[] | select(.tag_name | endswith($build))) // empty'
    )"
  fi

  [[ -n "$release_json" && "$release_json" != null ]] || \
    die "Could not find GTNH daily release: $GTNH_DAILY_BUILD"

  download_url="$(
    jq -r 'first(.assets[]? | select(
      .name | test("-server-java[0-9]+-[0-9]+\\.zip$")
    )) | .browser_download_url // empty' <<< "$release_json"
  )"
  [[ -n "$download_url" ]] || die "The selected daily release has no modern-Java server zip."

  prepare_pack "$download_url" "gtnh-daily-server.zip"
}

reset_tst_settings() {
  local path
  for path in "${TST_SETTINGS[@]}"; do
    rm -f "$BASE_DIR/$path"
  done
}

prepare_tst() {
  local api="https://api.github.com/repos/Nxer/Twist-Space-Technology-Mod/releases"
  local release_json asset_json url jar count installed old_version="" new_version
  local -a installed_jars
  TST_RESET="$TST_PENDING_RESET"

  if [[ "${TST_VERSION,,}" == latest ]]; then
    release_json="$(github_api_get "$api/latest")"
  else
    release_json="$(github_api_get "$api/tags/$TST_VERSION")"
  fi
  TST_RELEASE="$(jq -r '.tag_name // empty' <<< "$release_json")"
  [[ -n "$TST_RELEASE" ]] || die "Could not resolve TST release $TST_VERSION."
  asset_json="$(jq -c '[.assets[]? | select(
    (.name | test("^TwistSpaceTechnology-[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+\\.jar$")) and
    (.name | test("-(dev|sources|javadoc)\\.jar$"; "i") | not)
  )]' <<< "$release_json")"
  count="$(jq 'length' <<< "$asset_json")"
  [[ "$count" == 1 ]] || die "Expected one TST runtime jar in release $TST_RELEASE; found $count."
  jar="$(jq -r '.[0].name' <<< "$asset_json")"
  url="$(jq -r '.[0].browser_download_url // empty' <<< "$asset_json")"
  [[ "$url" == https://github.com/Nxer/Twist-Space-Technology-Mod/releases/download/* ]] ||
    die "Unexpected TST download URL."

  echo "Downloading TST $TST_RELEASE ($jar)..."
  download_file "$url" "$WORK_DIR/$jar"
  unzip -tq "$WORK_DIR/$jar" >/dev/null || die "Downloaded TST jar is not a valid archive."
  # Capture the listing before grep to avoid a pipefail/SIGPIPE false failure.
  local entries
  entries="$(unzip -Z1 "$WORK_DIR/$jar")"
  grep -qx 'mcmod.info' <<< "$entries" || die "Downloaded TST jar is missing mcmod.info."

  shopt -s nullglob
  installed_jars=("$BASE_DIR"/mods/TwistSpaceTechnology-*.jar "$BASE_DIR"/mods/TwistSpaceTechnology\ *.jar)
  shopt -u nullglob
  (( ${#installed_jars[@]} <= 1 )) ||
    die "Multiple installed TST jars found. Keep only the intended installed version before reinstalling."
  if (( ${#installed_jars[@]} == 1 )); then
    installed="${installed_jars[0]##*/}"
    old_version="${installed%.jar}"
    old_version="${old_version#TwistSpaceTechnology-}"
    old_version="${old_version#TwistSpaceTechnology }"
  fi
  new_version="${jar#TwistSpaceTechnology-}"
  new_version="${new_version%.jar}"
  if [[ -n "$old_version" && "${old_version#v}" != "${new_version#v}" ]]; then
    TST_RESET=true
    echo "TST version changed: $old_version -> $new_version. Config/lang files will be reset."
  elif [[ "$TST_PENDING_RESET" == true ]]; then
    echo "Completing the TST settings reset from the interrupted installation."
  elif [[ -n "$old_version" ]]; then
    echo "TST version unchanged ($new_version). Preserving config/lang files."
  else
    echo "No recognizable installed TST jar found. Preserving any existing config/lang files."
  fi

  mkdir -p "$EXTRACT_DIR/mods"
  find "$EXTRACT_DIR/mods" -maxdepth 1 -type f \
    \( -name 'TwistSpaceTechnology-*.jar' -o -name 'TwistSpaceTechnology *.jar' \) -delete
  cp "$WORK_DIR/$jar" "$EXTRACT_DIR/mods/$jar"
  chmod 644 "$EXTRACT_DIR/mods/$jar"
  rm -f "$WORK_DIR/$jar"
  echo "Check GTNH/TST compatibility: https://github.com/Nxer/Twist-Space-Technology-Mod#downloads--requirements"
}

archive_tst_settings() {
  local path archive_dir=""
  [[ "$TST_RESET" == true ]] || return 0
  # The interrupted attempt already made its permanent archive.
  [[ "$TST_PENDING_RESET" != true ]] || return 0
  for path in "${TST_SETTINGS[@]}"; do
    if [[ -e "$BACKUP_DIR/$path" ]]; then
      if [[ -z "$archive_dir" ]]; then
        mkdir -p "$BASE_DIR/.gtnh-tst-backups"
        archive_dir="$(mktemp -d "$BASE_DIR/.gtnh-tst-backups/$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-XXXXXX")"
      fi
      mkdir -p "$archive_dir/$(dirname "$path")"
      cp -a "$BACKUP_DIR/$path" "$archive_dir/$path"
    fi
  done
  if [[ -n "$archive_dir" ]]; then
    echo "Previous TST config/lang files saved to $archive_dir"
  fi
}

# Recover a completed snapshot before any cleanup or new installation attempt.
# An unmarked backup may be partial or belong to an older installer: keep it.
if [[ -e "$BACKUP_READY" ]]; then
  [[ -d "$BACKUP_DIR" ]] || die "Backup marker exists but $BACKUP_DIR is missing. Restore from a full backup before reinstalling."
  echo "Recovering preserved files from the interrupted installation..."
  copy_preserved_paths "$BACKUP_DIR" "$BASE_DIR"
  if [[ -e "$TST_RESET_MARKER" ]]; then touch "$TST_PENDING_MARKER"; fi
elif [[ -e "$BACKUP_DIR" ]]; then
  die "Unmarked backup found at $BACKUP_DIR. Keep it and recover the preserved files manually before removing $WORK_DIR and reinstalling."
fi

if [[ -e "$TST_PENDING_MARKER" ]]; then TST_PENDING_RESET=true; fi

rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
mkdir -p "$EXTRACT_DIR"

case "${GTNH_DAILY,,}" in
  true) download_daily_to_temp ;;
  false) download_stable_to_temp ;;
  *) die "GTNH_DAILY must be true or false." ;;
esac

prepare_tst

echo "Backing up preserved server files..."
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
copy_preserved_paths "$BASE_DIR" "$BACKUP_DIR"
archive_tst_settings
if [[ "$TST_RESET" == true ]]; then touch "$TST_RESET_MARKER" "$TST_PENDING_MARKER"; fi
touch "$BACKUP_READY"

echo "Replacing old GTNH pack files and folders..."
rm -rf \
  "$BASE_DIR/config" \
  "$BASE_DIR/libraries" \
  "$BASE_DIR/mods" \
  "$BASE_DIR/lwjgl3ify-forgePatches.jar" \
  "$BASE_DIR/java9args.txt"

rsync -a --no-perms \
  --exclude='.gtnh-install-work' \
  "$EXTRACT_DIR"/ "$BASE_DIR"/

echo "Restoring preserved server files..."
copy_preserved_paths "$BACKUP_DIR" "$BASE_DIR"
if [[ "$TST_RESET" == true ]]; then reset_tst_settings; fi
rm -f "$TST_PENDING_MARKER"

rm -rf "$WORK_DIR"
echo "Installation completed successfully. Refresh the page, then start the server."
